analytic.equation: pH(A) = pK + log10[(HCO3_reference - A) x (1 + g_v x A) / (s x PaCO2_reference)], pK 6.1, s 0.03, for 0 <= A < HCO3_reference (the P2K-3 mapping at efficiency 1 and the baseline demand)
analytic.inequality: d pH / dA = (1 / ln 10) x [g_v / (1 + g_v A) - 1 / (HCO3_reference - A)] = (1 / ln 10) x N(A) / [(1 + g_v A)(HCO3_reference - A)], with N(A) = (g_v x HCO3_reference - 1) - 2 g_v x A. On 0 <= A < HCO3_reference the denominator is positive (g_v >= 0), so the sign of the slope is the sign of N. N is linear in A with slope -2 g_v <= 0, so its largest value on the domain is N(0) = g_v x HCO3_reference - 1. pH is non-increasing on the whole domain if and only if N(0) <= 0, i.e. g_v <= 1 / HCO3_reference (strictly decreasing when g_v < 1 / HCO3_reference). When g_v > 1 / HCO3_reference, pH rises on 0 <= A < A* = (g_v x HCO3_reference - 1) / (2 g_v). Efficiency and demand ratio multiply PaCO2 by constants independent of A and drop out of the derivative.
analytic.scope: The bicarbonate at zero burden is the case's authored HCO3 plus its arrival burden: HCO3_reference when the authored HCO3 is at or below it (both GI cases). A family authored above the reference would carry 1 / its own zero-burden bicarbonate as the critical gain; that is a generalization question, not decided here.

faculty.goal: remove the paradox in which a higher metabolic acid burden raises pH at low burden because ventilation recruitment is too strong; then, with a non-empty coherent region, close the respiratory domain for the current GI calibration
faculty.identifiability: the gain narrowed by a structural rule is not WELL_CONSTRAINED; no choice of 0.03 or 0.04
faculty.no_saturation: no saturating recruitment and no new parameter now: the support already holds admissible values; a saturating form may be reconsidered if a second respiratory family shows the linear form is insufficient
faculty.priority: a coherent common physiology with explicit plausible uncertainty and no causal contradiction, good enough to migrate other families; not identifying every latent, a tighter fit of two GI cases or one best candidate
faculty.r3_r4: PHYSIOLOGICAL_RESPIRATORY_CONVERGENCE retained while the underlying states stay distinct
faculty.retained: intrinsic RR 12 / 16 / 20 per patient, the P2K-4 drive gains, B 13.4 / 19.4 / 28, tau 60 / 120 / 240, ventilation gain 0.03 / 0.04, HCO3_reference 24 and PaCO2_reference 40 provisional, arrival RR and PaCO2 +/- 3, BASELINE_RELATIVE demand; nothing else narrowed
faculty.reuse: P2K-4's survivors filtered by the gain alone when the subset is exact; never the full bitset pipeline again
faculty.rule: for increasing metabolic acid burden A, other physiology fixed, pH must be non-increasing: compensation may reduce the fall in pH, never reverse the metabolic load into alkalinization
faculty.scope: shadow only; no runtime integration, migration, parameter approval, consciousness or collapse; the upstream physiology reused, never reopened
faculty.treatment: a higher burden with a higher pH produced by excessive compensation is never respiratory improvement; no new numeric treatment threshold; once 0.05 / 0.06 are removed the condition is unreachable

design.policy: Shadow only. P2K-4's frozen code and record reused, never edited; the gain rejected by the analysis alone; no envelope, window, reference, tolerance, B, tau or other support changed; no new respiratory parameter or functional form; untreated pH never filters and the extreme-acidemia rows stay; the legacy never read; nothing selected or approved.
design.r3r4_rule: Not reopened. The underlying states (bleeding state, BloodState, chronology) read no respiratory latent, so P2K-4's result (no SCENARIO_STATE_COLLAPSE_BUG) holds for every pruned candidate; the respiratory gap is a maximum over the pair's surviving latent combinations, so the pruning can only keep a pair's class or move it from RESPIRATORY_OUTPUTS_DISTINCT to PHYSIOLOGICAL_RESPIRATORY_CONVERGENCE. P2K-4's counts are carried as the bound.
design.reach_rule: Frozen. Only what the pruning reaches is rebuilt: the R1 and R4 trajectories of every P2J-3 upstream survivor (R1 decides A-D and the extreme acidemia, R4 G, G2, H and I), by P2K-4's trajectory and summarize; their rule bitsets by P2K-4's unit_rules, with the certified rules (SIMULATION of the other trajectories, E, F) FULL. The crystalloid, red-cell, counterfactual and no-red-cell trajectories, the no-red-cell blood runs, the R3 / R4 core states, the P2K-3 reconstruction and the comparator validation are not rerun.
design.reuse_rule: Frozen. P2K-5's region is P2K-4's survivors with the ventilation gain in the admissible support. The reuse is exact when (1) the closed files keep their P2K-4 bytes and P2K-4's freeze digest recomputes (the rule digest of the reused code), (2) the P2K-4 record is the pinned one, (3) its certificates hold at both demands: SIMULATION, E and F never failed (so their bitsets are FULL for every unit), the ventilation gain is NON_IDENTIFIABLE with the filter not reading it (every unit's survivors identical at every gain), no survivor reading has a worse perfusion (the only class the corrected signal can move), R3 / R4 has no state-collapse bug; and (4) the reached recomputation, P2K-4's own functions on the R1 / R4 trajectories with the certified rules FULL, reproduces P2K-4's tally exactly at every demand (candidate identity). The pruned region is then those survivors masked by the gain; nothing else is rerun.
design.rule_scope: The bicarbonate at zero burden is the case's authored HCO3 plus its arrival burden: HCO3_reference when the authored HCO3 is at or below it (both GI cases). A family authored above the reference would carry 1 / its own zero-burden bicarbonate as the critical gain; that is a generalization question, not decided here.
design.semantic_rule: Frozen before any recount. The respiratory signal of a matched reading follows the metabolic acid load: a higher burden is respiratory worsening whatever the pH does (a pH rise beside it is excessive compensation, flagged PH_RISES_WITH_HIGHER_ACID_BURDEN, never improvement); a lower burden is improvement only when pH is also higher (a pH fall beside it is flagged PH_FALLS_WITH_LOWER_ACID_BURDEN and is not improvement); no burden change is no respiratory change. Perfusion, the classes, the rejecting classes (RESPIRATORY_AND_PERFUSION_WORSEN and a treated arrest), the comparators, the minutes and P2J-3's no-change tolerance (1e-9 of the scale) are P2K-4's; no numeric threshold is added. Against P2K-4 the only class that moves is RESPIRATORY_UNCHANGED_WITH_PERFUSION_WORSENING with a higher burden, which becomes RESPIRATORY_AND_PERFUSION_WORSEN (M1: the conjunction could not fire when overcompensation raised pH). M2: the pH direction is now read, through the paradox flags.

design.strategic_note: The current GI respiratory model is a MINIMAL spontaneous-breathing acid-compensation model. It does not yet establish general respiratory physiology for COPD, asthma, opioid hypoventilation, pneumonia, pulmonary edema or mechanical ventilation; those families will test whether the current RR / W / acid-base decomposition generalizes. Their physiology is not added preemptively.
design.verdict_rule: Frozen. EMPTY when no candidate survives the pruning at either demand (a STOP: no gain restored, nothing widened). CLOSED when every criterion holds: the upstream is unchanged (closed files at P2K-4's bytes, the P2J-3 region reproduced, every domain equal); the reuse is exact (REUSE_RULE, and the record's algebra equals the recomputed pruning); some candidate survives; pH is non-increasing in the burden for every retained gain (the analytic rule, the executable mapping equal to the analysed one, the probes); every pruned survivor's observables lie in A-I and its arrival windows; the treatment responses stay coherent under the corrected signal (no rejecting or perfusion-worse reading among the survivors, the declared transition only, no paradox reachable); no R3 / R4 state collapse; every other latent keeps its P2K-4 support and both admissible gains survive (no value chosen); the extreme-acidemia candidates stay in the region; nothing is approved. Otherwise NOT_READY with the first failing criterion as the blocker; an early stop lists what it never reached as not evaluated.
